content.short: Multicoin Capital is a thesis-driven investment firm investing in cryptocurrencies, tokens, and Blockchain companies.
content.description: Multicoin Capital is a thesis-driven investment firm focused on cryptocurrencies, tokens, and blockchain companies that are reshaping trillion-dollar markets. Since its inception in May 2017, Multicoin Capital has established itself as a leading entity in cryptocurrency investing, widely recognized for its rigorous research and thoughtful analysis, robust deal flow, and a strong, respected brand in the crypto industry. That reputation endures in a fast-changing market.
